description: This Java class is a Kafka message listener for a Spring Batch application in the Apache Fineract project. It listens to a Kafka topic for messages of type ContextualMessage, processes them via a StepExecutionRequestHandler, and uses an InputChannelInterceptor before handling. The class is annotated with Spring stereotypes and conditional logic for Kafka worker setup.

classes.name: KafkaRemoteMessageListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens to Kafka messages on a configurable topic, processes ContextualMessage objects, and delegates handling to a StepExecutionRequestHandler, with interceptors and acknowledgment management.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Callback method invoked when a Kafka message is received; it processes the message with input interception, handles exceptions, and acknowledges the message.
